slots.notes: White check glyph rendered inside each custom add-on checkbox when checked - a single reused inline-SVG mark (w-5 h-5 box) drawn in white over the accent-filled (#FF5656) square. The only typed asset socket in the template: no hero video, image, logo, or icon-set is shipped.

fontRoles.mono: font-mono (Tailwind/shadcn monospace utility on the uppercase tracking-widest eyebrow label; no concrete typeface family is declared)

colorRoles.bg: bg-background (shadcn semantic token for the full-width section; no concrete hex declared in the prompt)
colorRoles.fgMuted: text-muted-foreground (shadcn semantic token; no concrete hex declared)

mechanic: A two-column rounded-2xl card (left: a #0D0D0D form of divide-y-stacked radios / shadcn Slider / checkboxes / radios; right: a live cost-estimate panel) whose React useState drives a reactive pricing formula that re-renders three stacked cost cards, the brand card lit by a from-pink-500 to-orange-500 gradient.
techDelivery: Single-file React component spec on Tailwind utility classes with shadcn/ui (Slider + useToast); state via useState, prices formatted with toLocaleString(); no animation library.
reskinNotes: Accent #FF5656 is hardcoded inline across the radio dots, slider current-value text, checkbox fill, and the +$ add-on/timeline price labels. The headline brand card hardwires a two-stop from-pink-500 (#EC4899) to-orange-500 (#F97316) gradient - a literal palette pair, NOT a single accent - so accent2 maps to the far (orange) stop while the pink near-stop has no role and a faithful retint must edit both Tailwind stops. Two surface tones exist but only one surface role: the #0D0D0D form column (mapped) and the bg-muted/50 estimate cards (shadcn token, unmapped); the section bg (bg-background) and divider/border use semantic tokens (border-[#1E1E1E] vs border-white/10) so border carries two values too. All copy - including the literal brand name 'Webfluin Studio' / 'With Webfluin Studio' - and every numeric constant in the pricing logic (base/perPage tiers, agency 8000, freelancer 3000, +50/+100/+25 add-on deltas) are hardcoded in markup/JS, not data-driven. No display/body/accent typeface is named (only a font-mono eyebrow cue), so type reskin has no native family to map from. The checked-state check glyph is an inline SVG with its white fill baked in.
